item.title: Implement retry_budget.py to SPEC.md
item.brief: Implement retry_budget.py according to the repository's SPEC.md. Preserve the documented API and satisfy every specified error and boundary case. Add focused tests covering cases missing from the existing basic tests, using only the Python standard library. Run the relevant test suite, fix failures, and commit the completed work. Acceptance: implementation conforms to SPEC.md; documented API compatibility is preserved; focused tests exercise specified edge/error/boundary cases; checks pass; a commit is present.

pr.body: Implemented the documented pure function in retry_budget.py, including built-in int validation before exhaustion checks and efficient saturation for large attempts. Expanded test_retry_budget.py with focused validation, saturation, zero, cap, Retry-After, exhausted-attempt, and strict-budget cases. Checks: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest -v (11 passed); git diff --check (passed). Assumptions: none. First independent review identified missing validation-matrix tests; the follow-up commit adds them and a second reviewer passed the delta, resolving the finding.
pr.summary: Implemented retry delay scheduling. Callers now get validated capped backoff, Retry-After minimums, and strict budget enforcement; before, retry_delay raised NotImplementedError.
pr.title: Implement retry budget scheduling

agt_01M8GJBFHRZ6HW4F6Z7R4HNNYW:1.description: Focused tests do not cover validation of every argument across the specified invalid type and lower-bound cases. For example, there are no direct cases for invalid elapsed_ms, budget_ms, base_ms, cap_ms or max_attempts types, nor negative budget_ms/base_ms/cap_ms/retry_after_ms, nor attempt < 1. SPEC.md explicitly requires every argument to be a built-in int (excluding bool) and enforces per-argum

reviewer.why: The delta reviewer assessed the added tests alone as low risk; the overall implementation remains a behavior change.

risk.why: This is a contained behavior change to a pure public function in retry_budget.py plus focused tests. It has no external effects or dependencies; all specified boundary behavior is covered and checks pass. The implementation behavior change makes medium the appropriate advisory level.
